mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_record (vocab_id, quiz_type, is_correct, answered_at) VALUES (#{vocabId}, #{quizType}, #{isCorrect}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT vocab_id FROM quiz_record WHERE is_correct = false GROUP BY vocab_id ORDER BY MAX(answered_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT vocab_id FROM quiz_record WHERE is_correct = false
